tenon helpers -> builders/joinery.py; 45_coupon: E-seam clearance coupons (0.10/0.15/0.20, 1/2/3 notches) = two 20.5 mm offcuts trimmed at z 16.4 + Tenon_E copy each, in a Coupon collection at +X

Here is where we will start:

- The joints were all different sizes which made it challenging to fit together.
- We are missing some sort of bracing in the back for holding the picture in place
- There were very thin parts near the joints which made the material very fragile and broke when I was putting it together
- The material printed well and there was no weird pattersn on the surfaces
- The design and from was nice
- The joint in the middle of the frame was not a clean design, I would like for the joints to be at the edges and keep the pieces long (if possible on the bed we have)
- The joint itself should be heavily improved. I would like for us to do some more research towards what types of joints we could utilize instead as it seems like joints that snap in with the tenon might be better for us. 
- We should optimize the beds to hold more of the printed pieces
ah, something else we forgot to add was a hook or a notch to allow for the frame to be hung
I would like for the key hole to be centered on the top frame. Also, Im not convicned that the clips for keeping the back board in place will hold, are those glue only joints?
